confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain and assumes July peak-season rates, including taxes and fees. Hostel dorm and private-room anchors are the weakest because Paphos has few registered hostels. Drinks use a beer-based relationship (cocktail about 2.4x beer, wine glass about 1.45x beer). FX: the 0.6947 USD-per-AUD figure dated 2026-10-16 came from secondary sites reporting RBA rates. I did not open the RBA F11.1 table or the source_url page, so verify it against the official RBA data before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Mediterranean seaside resort towns in southern Europe with similar July tourism demand, adjusted for Cyprus price levels. Cyprus uses the euro. Accommodation is based on Kato Paphos and nearby resort-area pricing.
